name: @lamina/viewer
description: The web reader's framework-free viewer core (ADR 0009). Part 1 (C3a): one document worker per document, hosting @lamina/pdf and a RenderBackend, behind a typed RPC that extends @lamina/pdf/worker with priorities, coalescing, cancellation, timeouts and restart.

scripts.build:wasm: pnpm --filter @lamina/render --filter @lamina/render-pdfium run build && pnpm --filter @lamina/render-hayro run build:wasm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck:wasm: pnpm --filter @lamina/render --filter @lamina/render-pdfium run build && pnpm --filter @lamina/render-hayro run build:wasm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:wasm: pnpm --filter @lamina/render --filter @lamina/render-pdfium run build && pnpm --filter @lamina/render-hayro run build:wasm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vitest run -c vitest.node.config.ts
